verdict.rationale: Ramp documents rules-based approval workflows that route requests to the right stakeholders by vendor type, spend category, dollar amount, or team role. Its spend-controls guide describes approval workflows that apply across cards, reimbursements, bills, and agent purchases, which covers the routing core of the story. However, nothing shows explicit sequential chains (manager → budget owner → finance), approver delegation, or time-based escalation when approvers sit on requests. The AI agent's "escalates when it's not [safe]" is risk flagging, an adjacent feature, not approver-SLA escalation. Missing for 10: documented multi-step sequential approval chains, approver delegation/out-of-office reassignment, escalation or reminders for stalled approvals, independent or hands-on corroboration.
